C-BRAND-CENTRAL.Summary: Add Brand Central as an independent home service with the complete official GT7 catalogue, manufacturer showrooms, car history, specifications and photo galleries.
C-BRAND-CENTRAL.Problem: The app has separate used/legendary dealers and GT Auto, but lacks a manufacturer-centred catalogue for browsing every GT7 car and reading its real history.

Goals.Goal: Add a fifth Services entry and its own HomeShell route, alongside the existing dealers, GT Auto and Apex.
Provide region/brand selection, an all-cars view, manufacturer showroom and a car detail screen inspired by GT6, GT Sport and GT7.
Use official stable car IDs to connect real manufacturer names/logos, countries, stock specifications, original descriptions and all available photos.
Support system-default Russian/English content, explicit source attribution, retry, safe missing-data states and responsive layouts.

Constraints.Constraint: Follow Provider/ChangeNotifier architecture, central DI and auto_route; new feature UI belongs under lib/widgets/brand_central.
Use the FVM-pinned SDK and preserve GT Auto, Apex, audio and the existing dealer behaviour.
Parse official public data without executing remote JavaScript. Discover hashed module URLs; validate schemas, hosts, IDs and units.
Cover all official-catalogue cars; do not imply every listed car is sold in the game's new-car Brand Central.
History text must come from the official catalogue, with attribution; absent data remains unknown.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No game purchase/install controls, invented prices, generated history, full brand museum timeline, 3D viewer or unsupported paint selector.
No telemetry/profile redesign, unrelated native renderer crash repair, deployment, commit or push in this change.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Home exposes five independent Services cards with working navigation and a content-height responsive layout.
Brands and all-cars views cover the official catalogue, with working region filtering, search, sort and an empty-search result.
Selecting a brand opens its cars; selecting a car shows its real photo, original Russian/English history and labelled official specifications.
Gallery supports every available frame, previous/next or swipe and full-image viewing; failed image or text loads expose fallback/retry.
Back navigation returns through car, showroom and brand selection to Home without discarding the user's filter or list position.
Rapid car/language changes cannot display a stale response for a previous selection; cached records avoid repeated bulk requests.
Widget tests cover 320, 390, 600, 820, 1024, 1280 and 1920 logical widths and text scale 1.5 without overflow.
Exercise the new service in the running macOS app with live official data, history, gallery, back navigation and multiple window sizes; record screenshots and errors.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: FVM Dart analysis of changed modules
Flutter parser, repository, widget and navigation tests
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Live official catalogue coverage, car history and gallery, source attribution, native macOS screenshots and runtime-error inspection.

Assumptions.Assumption: The fifth card is placed before the existing four cards; their relative order remains unchanged.
First content languages are System, Russian and English. Other system languages use English.
A full brand-event museum timeline requires a separate confirmed data source and is outside this first implementation; car-model history is included.
The user is reviewing this concrete scope before an approved executable plan is created.
